senses.gloss: पट्ट- + उपाध्याय पट्ट- + उपाध्याय, m. a dispatcher of documents (master of the rolls?), Rājat. 5, 396.
पटाक्षेप पटाक्षेप, i. e. पट-अ-क्षेप, m. not drawing away the curtain(?).

पट् पट्, † i. 1, Par. To go, to move.
 --i. 10, पाटय,
 1. † To speak, or to shine.
 2. To split, to divide, MBh. 3, 16747; 882.
 3. To break, to breach, Mṛcch. 47, 16.
 4. To tear, Kathās. 20, 21.
 5. To pluck out, 28, 21.
 6. To cause to be torn up, Yājñ. 2, 94.
 7. † i. 10, पटय, To string, to surround.
 --With the prep. अव अव, पाटय, To split, Suśr. 1, 32, 12.
 --With आ आ, पाटय, To split, Suśr. 2, 22, 19.
 --With उद् उद्, पाटय,
 1. To tear out, Man. 4, 69.
 2. To slit up, Rājat. 5, 432.
 3. To open, Pañc. 222, 5.
 4. To destroy, Rām. 6, 88, 19.
 5. To remove, 6, 37, 87.
 6. To dethrone, Rājat. 5, 298.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, पाटय,
 1. To tear out, Rām. 5, 39, 23.
 2. To draw out, Dev. 2, 20.
 3. To dethrone, Rājat. 5, 286. []
 --With विनि वि-नि, पाटय, To split, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 16.
 --With वि वि, पाटय,
 1. To split, MBh. 12, 591.
 2. To tear, Hariv. 4310.
 3. To uproot, Rājat. 5, 477.
 4. To open, 3, 482 (to bring on).

पट पट (probably for पत्र), m. and f. टी, and n.
 1. Woven cloth, MBh. 1, 806.
 2. Cloth, Rām. 5, 49, 5.
 3. A piece of cloth, MBh. 1, 4376.
 4. Garment, 5421.
 5. (cf. पट्ट), A table, a plate (for painting and writing), Yājñ. 1, 297.
 6. f. टी, The curtain of a stage.
 --Comp.

पट्ट पट्ट, probably for पत्र, m.
 1. A table, a plate, for painting, Hariv. 9988.
 2. A patent, a document, Yājñ. 1, 317.
 3. A seat, a chair, MBh. 2, 90.
 4. A bandage, a ligature, Suśr. 1, 15, 3.
 5. A stripe, MBh. 13, 3456.
 6. A frontlet, a diadem, a turban or cloth, etc., for that purpose, Kathās. 14, 33.
 7. (cf. पट) Cloth, Pañc. 251, 16.
 8. A proper name.
 --Comp.

पटच्चर पटच्चर, i. e. पटत् (from पट्, an imitative sound, perhaps of sneaking) -चर,
 I. m.
 1. A thief, MBh. 1, 6996.
 2. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 590.
 II. n. Old cloth.
पाटच्चर पाटच्चर, i. e. पटच्चर + अ, m. A thief, a robber.
पटभाक्ष पटभाक्ष, m. or n. An implement for looking, or spying, Daśak. 71, 4.

पटल पटल,
 I. n.
 1. A roof.
 2. A coverture, a veil, Prab. 116, 15.
 3. A film over the eyes, Suśr. 2, 277, 4.
 4. A heap, a multitude, MBh. 12, 4249.
 II. m. and n. A section of a book.
 --Comp.

पाटल पाटल,
 I. adj., f. ला.
 1. Of a pale red colour, Ragh. 7, 24.
 2. Pallid, Śāk. d. 182.
 II. m.
 1. Pale red, rose colour, Ragh. 4, 68.
 2. A kind of rice ripening in the rains.
 3. A proper name.
 4. The tree of trumpet flower, Bignonia suaveolens.
 III. f. ला, The tree and its flower.
 IV. n. Its flower, Pañc. i. d. 152.
 --Comp.
पटलक पटल + क (m. or n.). A heap, Kathās. 43, 27.

पटह पट-ह (vb. हन्), m. (and n.). A drum, a kettle-drum, Pañc. 261, 13.
 --Comp.
पटि पटि (for पटी, cf. पट), f. A kind of cloth, Pañc. 236, 25.

पटु पट् + उ,
 I. adj., f. टु and ट्वी, comparat. पटीयंस्, superl. पटिष्ठ.
 1. Sharp, Śāntiś. 4, 16.
 2. Hot, Rām. 6, 11, 44.
 3. Clear (of sound), Hariv. 3554.
 4. Violent, Hariv. 3823.
 5. Clever, dexterous, skilful, Ragh. 9, 46.
 II. m. pl. The name of a people, Mārk. P. 57, 54.
पटुता पटु + ता, f.; in वाक्पटुता, i. e. वाच्-, Eloquence, Bhartṛ. 2, 53.

पटुत्व पटु + त्व, n.
 1. Keenness, Bālab. 3.
 2. Cleverness, Śāk. d. 118.
 --Comp.
पटोल पटोल, A kind of cucumber; Trichosanthes dioeca, Roxb. m. The plant. n. The fruit, Pañc. i. d. 423.

पट्टक पट्ट + क,
 I. m.
 1. A document, Rājat. 5, 396.
 2. A bandage, Kathās. 28, 159.
 3. A frontlet, Kathās. 13, 190.
 II. f. टिका,
 1. A ribbon, Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 14.
 2. Cloth used for a turban, Rājat. 4, 575.
 --Comp.
पाटक पाटक, i. e. पट् + अक, m. One who divides, Hariv. 9767.
पट्टज पट्ट-ज (vb. जन्), n. A sort of cloth, MBh. 2, 1847.
पट्टव पट्ट + व(?). A sort of cloth, Rājat. 5, 161 (probably corr. पट्टज).

पाटव पाटव, i. e. पटु + अ, n.
 1. Sharpness, energy.
 2. Cleverness, dexterity, Hit. pr. d. 2.
 3. Quickness, precipitation, Kathās. 5, 89.
पट्टिश पट्टिश, m. A spear with a sharp edge, Rām. 1, 54, 22.
पट्टिशिन् पट्टिशिन्, i. e. पट्टिश + इन्, adj. Armed with a paṭṭiśa, Hariv. 15114.

पाटन पाटन, i. e. पट् + अन, n.
 1. Ripping up, slitting up, Mārk. P. 14, 88.
 2. Opening, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1405.

पाटलि पाटलि,
 I. m. and f., and पाटली पाटली, f.
 1. Trumpet flower, Bignonia suaveolens.
 II. पाटली, f.
 1. The name of a tree.
 2. A proper name.
पाटलिमन् पाटलिमन्, i. e. पाटल + इमन्, m. Pale red, rose colour, Prab. 85, 2.
पाटलि- + पुत्र पाटलि- + पुत्र, n. the name of a town, the Palibothra of the ancients.
पाटलि- + पुत्रक पाटलि- + पुत्रक, n. the name of a town, the Palibothra of the ancients.
पट- + मण्डप पट- + मण्डप, m. and n. a tent, Ragh. 5, 73.
पट- + रचना पट- + रचना, f. art of making cloth, Pañc. 132, 24.
पट- + वास पट- + वास, [] m. perfumed powder, Gīt. 1, 35.
